The complex function of two variables

Numerical objects ›› Numerical objects of calculation type ››


A complex function of two variables is created via icon of the calculations expandable bar (third from the bottom).

Such a function may be modified through icon .

For instance,you can define a real function of two variables by choosing f for name, z and z' for the variables names and 2*Re(z^2)*z'+ 3*z + z' + 1 fro formula.


See also : Complex calculus syntax.
